faqs.q: What transactions are eligible for cashback on AU InstaPay Credit Card?
faqs.a: AU InstaPay Credit Card offers 1% cashback on eligible UPI transactions made at departmental stores, dining outlets, pharmacies, and grocery and supermarket stores. The cashback is offered on a minimum transaction of Rs. 200.

faqs.q: Can AU InstaPay Credit Card be used for UPI payments at any merchant?
faqs.a: Yes. The card can be linked to a supported UPI app and used for Scan & Pay transactions at eligible merchants. However, cashback is applicable only on transactions that fall under the eligible cashback categories.

faqs.q: What is the minimum fuel transaction required to avail the surcharge waiver?
faqs.a: The 1% fuel surcharge waiver is applicable on fuel transactions between Rs. 400 and Rs. 5,000 at all fuel stations. Transactions outside this specified range may not qualify for the waiver.

faqs.q: How does the interest-free period on AU InstaPay Credit Card work?
faqs.a: The card offers an interest-free period of up to 50 days, which includes the period from the transaction date until the payment due date. The actual interest-free period varies depending on when the transaction is made within the billing cycle.

faqs.q: Is AU InstaPay Credit Card useful for consumers who do not use UPI frequently?
faqs.a: The card may offer limited value to consumers who do not use UPI regularly, as its primary benefit is 1% cashback on eligible UPI spends. Such consumers can consider other cards offering rewards or cashback on their preferred spending categories.

faqs.q: Can I link AU InstaPay Credit Card to a UPI app?
faqs.a: Yes. The card can be linked to any supported UPI app, allowing cardholders to make Scan & Pay transactions using their credit card.
